infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: REPLAY requires camera access to capture autobiographical memory moments.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: REPLAY requires photo library access to organize and relate your memories.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: REPLAY uses your location to record memory coordinates and geofences.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: REPLAY uses background location to log entries to your Life Graph places.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow REPLAY to take photos for your memories.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow REPLAY to detect when you visit Life Graph places.
